searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Product names or tariff codes, for example "integrated solar panel" or "6109.10.0040". Codes are reformatted automatically: CROSS groups ten digits 4.2.4, so a code copied from the tariff schedule in 4.2.2.2 form would otherwise return nothing.

rulingNumbers.title: Ruling numbers
rulingNumbers.description: Fetch specific rulings directly, for example N160415 or H305865. These always return the full ruling text, because that is the only thing the ruling endpoint serves.

collection.title: Collection
collection.description: New York rulings are the high-volume classification rulings. Headquarters rulings carry more weight and often decide contested questions.

sortBy.title: Sort order
sortBy.description: Newest first is the default because relevance order returns 1990s rulings ahead of current ones.

dateFrom.title: From ruling date
dateFrom.description: Earliest ruling date as YYYY-MM-DD. CBP has no server-side date filter, so this is applied after fetching and rulings with no recorded date are excluded.

onlyCurrentPrecedent.title: Skip superseded rulings
onlyCurrentPrecedent.description: Drop rulings that CROSS records as revoked or modified. CBP returns those alongside live ones with nothing to tell them apart, and citing one is a real problem at entry.

includeFullText.title: Include full ruling text
includeFullText.description: Fetch the complete ruling body: the reasoning, the product description CBP worked from, and the classification it landed on. Costs one extra request per ruling and is charged at the higher rate.

newOnly.title: Monitor mode: new rulings only
newOnly.description: Remember rulings already returned and emit only ones not seen before. Pair it with newest-first sorting and a saved search to watch for new precedent on your products. Quiet runs cost nothing.
